label: Native Demo Auto-Record
description: Arms/disarms minqlxtended's native per-player demo capture (demo_arm/demo_disarm) on game_countdown/game_end, so server-side .dm_91 recording starts exactly at match start (not warmup) and ships as a countdown-trimmed, match-named .qlmatch package. Packaging runs in the external qlmatch-packer process (deployed to /home/ql/qlmatch-packer/ by host setup / Update Plugins), which also renders the filename template and delivers the pack via rclone. Requires a minqlxtended build with the demo-match/demo-cutter/demo-bindings patch chain applied (qlds_engine_flavor=minqlxtended, source=build).

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns native server-side match demo recording on or off. Do not combine with sv_demoRecord — that's the old, match-unaware upstream toggle this plugin replaces.

cvars.label: .qlmatch name template
cvars.description: Filename template for the finished .qlmatch (no extension). Placeholders: {match_id} {date} {time} {map} {gametype} {players} {pov_players} {total_players} {red_count} {blue_count} {red_players} {blue_players} {teams}. Empty = {match_id}_{map}. Values are sanitized for filenames; if the rendered name has no match stamp and already exists, _{match_id} is appended instead of overwriting.

cvars.label: .qlmatch rclone targets
cvars.description: Comma-separated rclone destinations the finished .qlmatch is copied to (e.g. gdrive:ql-demos/frontier,/home/ql/qlmatch-archive). Each entry is passed to `rclone copy` on the game host — rclone must be installed and its remotes configured there (rclone config). Empty = keep the file local only.

cvars.label: Packer script path
cvars.description: Path to the external qlmatch-packer entrypoint on the game host. When missing (or node is not installed), the plugin falls back to a plain in-process zip build without templating/delivery.
